verification_composition: Broad integration regression plus targeted race runs after the final source-lookup, source-deletion and versioned identity/provenance changes. Counts include Go test and subtest cases; repeated runs are not unique-case totals.

checks.scope: Broad integration regression before the final targeted changes.
Preparation recovery, lifecycle and inventory race cases, including stale claims and scan-specific coverage. No importer tests match this filter; its 120 cases ran in the broad integration suite.
Final one-query accepted-source lookup and inventory behavior.

Final versioned acceptance identity and failed-attempt provenance serialization.

scope_limit: Controller/service/store/importer/public API integration is verified using ordinary Run submission and controlled terminal outputs on PostgreSQL. The real generated-flow process/browser gate remains V62-012. Richer provenance and dedicated preparation UI remain V62-010/011. V62-005/006/007/008 remain deferred.

acceptance.A1: Equivalent reordered JSON/YAML generated OpenAPI creates three deterministically attributed operation items with matching canonical digest, exact retained source identity and explicit unsupported-webhook gap. The prepared SQLMap profile creates three selected scan items with scan-specific coverage and approval reviews.
acceptance.A2: Prepared checklist-to-report integration, direct-input regressions and standards paths pass. Original baseline bytes remain immutable and accepted derived inventory is stored as a separate protected exact artifact; source Run deletion before inventory construction is covered.
acceptance.A3: Malformed, empty and over-limit generated inputs fail explicitly before a Round exists. Only accepted mapped outputs resolve as inventory sources; partial failed-attempt evidence is never accepted dependency input.
acceptance.A4: Concurrent identical acceptance inserts one Round, item set, coverage/review ledger and derived link with bytes charged once; changed replay conflicts. Crash/replay package publication, stale claim, pause, deadline, cancel and delete fences produce no authoritative orphan items.
